interval_scope: Conditional resampling intervals for the observed outcome/OOF-prediction records. No training or tuning is refitted; intervals do not cover full training-algorithm uncertainty or guarantee coverage for nested-CV generalization performance.

multiplicity.primary_family: Nine Spearman-difference estimands: eight prespecified drugs plus one equal-drug macro for REO EN versus expression EN.
multiplicity.secondary_family: Separate nine-estimand Spearman-difference family for REO RF versus expression RF; exploratory secondary, not a second route to declare the main EN successful.
multiplicity.adjustment: Bonferroni percentile endpoints alpha/(2*9) and 1-alpha/(2*9); also report marginal 95% intervals.
multiplicity.interpretation: Nominal family-adjusted conditional bootstrap intervals, not exact simultaneous coverage of algorithmic performance. Primary and secondary families are distinct; no combined guarantee across both families.
multiplicity.auxiliary_metrics: Unadjusted 95% conditional intervals, labelled descriptive; no multiplicity-unadjusted confirmatory claims.

failure_task_policy.training_mean_spearman: Always NA as an individual-ranking baseline, even if concatenated fold means differ.
failure_task_policy.constant_response_or_prediction: Spearman NA with reason; R2 NA for constant response; preserve RMSE/MAE and task records.
failure_task_policy.missing_prediction_or_incomplete_repeat: Retain and flag task as incomplete. Do not calculate primary mean/CI from a subset of its three repeats or silently reduce N.
failure_task_policy.zero_molecular_coefficients: Preserve global prediction metrics but identify tissue-only EN components; global Spearman is not molecular evidence.
